text: __NOTOC__ Timberling Mire Beasts are bog beasts found in Teldrassil.
Timber Worg Tail drops from the following wolves in Terokkar Forest: *Ironjaw *Timber Worg *Timber Worg Alpha

Timbermaw Shaman are furbolgs found in Azshara's section of Timbermaw Hold and in Ursolan. Killing them resulted in -25 reputation with the Timbermaw Hold reputation. Since the Cataclysm, they were replaced by Blackmaw Shaman.
Timber Worg Pelts drops from Timber Worgs and Timber Worg Alphas in Terokkar Forest.

Timberstriders are tallstriders found on Azuremyst Isle. They are identical in appearance to the other timberstriders listed below, the foreststriders in Darkshore, and the Greater Plainstriders in the Northern Barrens.
Timberstrider Fledglings are tallstriders found on Azuremyst Isle.
Timberling Bark Rippers are bog beasts located at Lake Al'Ameth in Teldrassil.
Tilda Darathan is a priestess who was sent with Orik Trueheart on behalf of the Argent Crusade to quell the unfortunate damned souls attempting to escape Wintergarde.
Tillinghast's Plague Canister is provided for the quest Green Eggs and Whelps.
Timbermaw Offering of Peace is provided as an objective for The Brokering of Peace.
Timeless Beads of Eternos drop from Drakos the Interrogator in the Oculus on normal mode.
Tilted! is awarded to players after defeated another player in a mounted duel at the Argent Tournament.
The Tiki Hex Remover is a level 1 item, dropped by Enchanted Tiki Warriors, that can remove hexes.
Tilesets are the terrains that maps are created in for the Warcraft series of games. Each tileset usually comes with its own set of critters and creeps.

Timear Foresees was an achievement awarded by completing the Northrend daily instance quests. Only one of these quests are available per day, at random, from Archmage Timear outside of the Violet Hold in Dalaran.
Time Keepers are bronze drakes summoned with Chrono-Beacon. They will assist players during the Opening the Dark Portal encounter.
Timbermaw Warders are furbolgs located at Timbermaw Hold in northern Felwood. Killing them reduces your reputation with the Timbermaw Hold faction.

Timbermaw Den Watchers are furbolgs located in northern Azshara in the regions of Timbermaw Hold and Ursolan. Killing them reduced your reputation with the Timbermaw Hold faction. Since the Cataclysm, they were replaced by the Blackmaw tribe.

Timbermaw Pathfinders are furbolgs located north of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara in Bear's Head and near Timbermaw Hold. Killing them reduced your reputation with the Timbermaw Hold faction. Since the Cataclysm, they were replaced by Blackmaw Pathfinders.

Timbermaw Totemics are furbolgs located north of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara in Bear's Head. Killing them reduced your reputation with the Timbermaw Hold faction. Since the Cataclysm, they were replaced by the furbolgs of the Blackmaw tribe.

Timbermaw Ursa are furbolgs located in Ursolan in Azshara. Killing them reduced your reputation with the Timbermaw Hold faction. Since the Cataclysm, they were replaced by the furbolgs of the Blackmaw tribe.

Timbermaw Warriors are furbolgs located north of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara in Bear's Head and near Timbermaw Hold. Killing them reduced your reputation with the Timbermaw Hold faction. Since the Cataclysm, they were replaced by Blackmaw Warriors.
Timbermaw Woodbenders are furbolgs located at Timbermaw Hold in northern Felwood. Killing them reduces your reputation with the Timbermaw Hold faction.
Time-Clearing Bracers are a quest reward from An Occupation of Time.
Timberline Arms is a weapon shop found in the Military Ward of Ironforge.
Timeless Dreadstone is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting.

Tiki Target is a training dummy mob in the troll starting area intended to allow new players to practice on them via quest. Novice Darkspear Druid and similar NPCs stand round attacking them to simulate the idea of training an army and thus work the newbie quest into the storyline. It has a short respawn rate.
Tile of Glazed Clay is a common archaeology artifact that requires 45 Orc Archaeology Fragments to complete, and allows the use of two Keystones.
Timeless Shadow Draenite is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting.

Tim Hayward is one of five Hayward brothers that own and operate the Hayward Fishery in Gilneas. They have operated it for a number of years, but are forced to flee when the Forsaken invasion occurs, coupled with the seismic activity of the Cataclysm. They are successful in gathering their supplies and making repairs to their boats, but nothing is ever heard from them again after their expected departure to the sea.
Time Altered Legguards can be found inside Murozond's Temporal Cache after defeating Murozond in End Time.
Time Twisted Tunic can be found inside Murozond's Temporal Cache after defeating Murozond in End Time.
Time-Twisted Sentinel are night elf Sentinel mobs lurking in the perpetual darkness of the Emerald Dragonshrine in End Time.
Time-Twisted Huntresses are night elf huntresses mobs lurking in the perpetual darkness of the Emerald Dragonshrine in End Time.
Time-Twisted Nightsabers are nightsaber mobs lurking in the perpetual darkness of the Emerald Dragonshrine in End Time.
Time-Twisted Geists are geists mobs squirming around the Ruby Dragonshrine in End Time.
Time-Twisted Scourge Beasts are plague eruptors mobs limping around the Ruby Dragonshrine in End Time.
Time-Twisted Shadowtalons are undead eagles swooping around the Ruby Dragonshrine in End Time. They can be found feasting on the corpse of a dead Time-Twisted Scourge Beast and are non-elite.
Time-Twisted Sorceresses are high elven sorcerers walking the Azure Dragonshrine in End Time.
Time-Twisted Priests are high elven priests walking the Azure Dragonshrine in End Time.
Time-Twisted Riflemen are dwarven riflemen walking the Azure Dragonshrine in End Time.
Time-Twisted Footmen are human footmen walking the Azure Dragonshrine in End Time.
Tiki Lord Zim'wae is an enchanted tiki found in front of the Temple of Bethekk in Zul'Gurub.
__NOTOC__ The Time Warden is a bronze drake that has been captured by Twilight's Hammer and is being held in the Bastion of Twilight.
Time-Worn Breastplate is a quest item for Ambushed! (Western Plaguelands).

The Tillers (short for the Tiller's Union or Tillers Union) are a group of pandaren farmers who harvest and produce crops to feed their people. They were seemingly founded by a man only referred to as "the Tiller".

The Timeless Shore is the western beach of Timeless Isle. The Huojin Landing is found at the beach's northern extent, the Tushui Landing at the southern end, Blackguard's Forgotten Cove is offshore further west, and the Celestial Court is inland to the east.
Timeless Spirits are mogu ghosts located in the Spirit Realm version of the Cavern of Lost Spirits on the Timeless Isle.
A decent number of Timeless Chests are found at along the walls of Kukuru's Grotto. Each chest requires a Kukuru's Cache Key to open, which can be purchased from for each.
The Time-Worn Journal is sold by in exchange for . It was written by the explorer J. M. Harrington, who was traveling on the Barnacle.

Time-Lost Shrines are found all over the Timeless Isle. They are always present on the isle, but only occasionally will they reactivate. The first player to use the shrine after it reactivates gains a buff, and then the shrine deactivates itself for a time. Interacting with one will provide an hour-long buff given by one of the four August Celestials: * ** * ** * ** * **

Timeless armor tokens are somewhat common drops from all mobs on the Timeless Isle, found much more commonly on rare and rare elite mobs, and additionally are often found inside any treasure chest on the isle. As acquired, timeless loot tokens are bind to account and will create an item level 496 randomly-enchanted item that is usable for the player's currently-selected loot specialization. By using a Burden of Eternity on any of the below tokens, players can instead create an item level 535 epic randomly-enchanted item, rather than a 496 item. All items created in this way will have a green "" tag at the top of the tooltip.

The Timeless Cloth Armor Cache is purchased from Mistweaver Ai for . Additionally, the one-time quest Time In Your Hands and Rolo's Riddle (3) offers the choice of this among the other three loot caches. Using this item directly creates any of the Timeless armor token-created items.

The Timeless Mail Armor Cache is purchased from Mistweaver Ai for . Additionally, the one-time quest Time In Your Hands offers the choice of this among the other three loot caches. Using this item directly creates any of the Timeless armor token-created items.

The Timeless Leather Armor Cache is purchased from Mistweaver Ai for . Additionally, the one-time quest Time In Your Hands offers the choice of this among the other three loot caches. Using this item directly creates any of the Timeless armor token-created items.

Time-Lost Artifact is purchased from for at standing with Emperor Shaohao.

Timeless Nutriment is an exploration achievement earned for consuming all of the sources on the Timeless Isle.

Timeless Champion is an exploration achievement earned for killing all of the rare creatures on Timeless Isle. Most Timeless Champions have a respawn time in the 30 minute–1 hour window, and spawn independently of any other mobs. The Emerald Gander, Imperial Python, Ironfur Steelhorn, and Monstrous Spineclaw each have a slim chance to spawn instead of their normal versions, and can respawn as frequently as instantly. For example, to spawn the Ironfur Steelhorn, keep killing groups of normal and elite yaks. Till the Break of Dawn is a quest achievement earned for successfully harvesting 100 crops.
Timeless Legends is an exploration achievement earned for finding all of the lost pandaren artifacts on the Timeless Isle.

The Tillers Shrine is a small shrine at the Sunsong Ranch, owned by Farmer Yoon after being inherited by his grandfather, the tiller Old Yoon. The shrine is part of the acceptance process into the Tillers: The five council members of the Tillers must acknowledge the one aspiring to be a tiller by placing a rice bowl with a stick of incense in it. The adventurer can use the shrine to check how high their friendship is with each of the individual Tillers.

.]] Time is a progression of instants. This movement is ordinarily perceived by mortals as regular and determinant, functioning much like a clockwork; yet perception does not dictate reality: time is chaotic, always in flux, and completely malleable, flowing like the sands of an hourglass. While there is an infinite number of timeways, according to Aman'Thul, leader of the Pantheon, there is only "one true timeline", although some would have it otherwise, and without the truth of time as it is meant to unfold, the fabric of reality will unravel. Timber Lords are the ultimate murderers of trees, and only the most murderous and sadistic of tree-killing Orcs get to become one. The Timber Lords were trained by Saurfang himself, because while everyone were killing each other, nobody were killing the trees, so he trained them in order for the trees to have something to fear apart from those who needed shelter. Timber Lords have existed for a long time, and predates World of Warcraft. They are a Hero class that is unavailable to the majority of players. Tirisfal Glades (also known as the Tirisfal Glade or simply Tirisfal, pronounced TEER-ihs-fahl) is an eerie region found on the northern coast of Lordaeron. It was named after the Titan Keeper Tyr, as Tirisfal means "Tyr's Fall" in the vrykul tongue. The lands of the Forsaken, the wooded hills are seeped through with the curse of the Lich King's plague. The sky over Tirisfal is eternally gloomy and tinted a blighted green, and the trees and other flora desperately cling to their last shreds of life. Tiragarde Keep is an Alliance stronghold located in the Scuttle Coast in Durotar. It was previously manned by soldiers loyal to Admiral Daelin Proudmoore, Lord of Kul Tiras, and was ruined in a battle against the Horde. After Daelin's death, a reserve force under Lieutenant Benedict took control of the ruins and continued the Admiral's crusade against the orcs. Almost all of his forces were killed in the Cataclysm, and were soon replaced by Theramore soldiers from Northwatch, aiming to maintain this stubborn Alliance foothold in Durotar.

Timolain was a human mage commissioned by the Scarlet Crusade to create weapons. After he attempted to create a dark "counterpart" to the Ashbringer, Grand Inquisitor Isillien killed him. However, Timolain had created a phylactery, which eventually allowed him to resurrect as a lich.

The Tinkers' Court, also called high tinker's court, is a room within Gnomeregan, located beyond the Dark Iron-filled tunnels leading from the Launch Bay's and Engineering Labs' lower levels. Tinkmaster Overspark was a member of the ruling council.
